nodes.label: Finding 28b-06 - the block carries the attribution
nodes.rationale: Register 1721 records the attribution act itself and Chapter 36 states the same act in its own words at 36.3, citing registers 1718 and 1722-1723. R.7's block is where the works are printed and where the claim about the chapters is made; the chapter neither needs nor makes it.

nodes.label: Finding 28b-07 - the sentence is true, the container over-reaches
nodes.rationale: Chapter 36 names ten of the three-body block's works and the newest year among them is 2015, Montgomery's own; the six that post-date him appear in no part of the chapter. What over-reaches is the BLOCK's scope, not the sentence and not the chapter.

nodes.label: Finding 28b-08 - twelve names, not eight
nodes.rationale: Baker, Dechter, Montanari and Pixley - the constraint-consistency line at L11839 - sit in 1721's tenth owner-group, in no other entry of 1713-1724 and in no part of Chapter 36. The record's list is a subset.

nodes.label: CONVENTION PROV
nodes.rationale: Where a claim is printed inside a list but addressed to something outside it, the reading scores it against the thing it is addressed to. Corollary that decided the unit: a claim can be true of its subject and false of its container, and a probe looking for the container's contents inside the subject reports the claim unsupported when the claim is sound.

nodes.label: Register 1721
nodes.rationale: Prints ten owner-groups against its stated seven closures. Engaged and NOT scored: a question may close to more than one group and the audit-7 ledger mapping question to owner is not a member of this build, so the reading cannot decide it.

nodes.label: Census reg 1546 - closed as a defect
nodes.rationale: The C13 handle leak 3B.tri at L6403 sits inside register 1716, which this reading read entire; the class is already ruled (26b-10, ruling 46, docket 28) with 1536 and 1556 closed on the same form, so no new ruling was made. First of the chat's four units to close an engaged row - because the reading did take the entry the row sits in.
